minutes.headline: School Committee voted unanimously by roll call to appoint Dr. Kate Burnham superintendent; she accepted.
minutes.summary: The meeting opened with the retiree reception and a student report on the Nashville music trip. The committee then discussed its superintendent candidates, took a roll call, and recessed to call the chosen candidate, who accepted. It approved the middle school improvement plan and handbook and a France and Spain trip, waived policy readings, heard subcommittee reports on middle school athletics, and ended in executive session on union negotiations.

what_happened.line: The School Committee voted unanimously by roll call to appoint Dr. Kate Burnham as superintendent, and she accepted after a recess.
Contract negotiations with attorneys follow the acceptance, with the next meeting set for June 20.
The committee approved the Lunenburg Middle School 2018-19 improvement plan and handbook.
It approved a France and Spain trip and waived readings of policies, including one adding pregnancy conditions as a protected class.
Middle school field hockey and basketball proposers are to be put on a future agenda after interest is gauged; the meeting ended in executive session on union negotiations.

why_it_matters: The superintendent runs the district's budget proposal and staffing, so this appointment shapes the school budget residents vote on at Town Meeting, and the contract terms are still to be negotiated.
Proposed middle school field hockey and basketball programs were described as funded by user fees and parent funding, so any cost to families or the school budget depends on decisions not yet made.
